copy.annual: Annual billing is two months free, paid in advance.
copy.annualDetail: An annual price is ten months paid in advance (two months free).
copy.notCharged: We do not charge per retry, per simulation, or per transition.
copy.overage: Automatic overage billing is not switched on. A workspace that needs more than its plan moves to the next plan, or to an invoice you agree by email. There is no surprise per-call charge.
copy.softOverage: Soft overage is the intended path past a limit; we will not charge per retry, per simulation, or per transition.

meters.title: Workflow publications
meters.body: A new WorkflowClass, a new version, or a material republish. Active published workflows are shown separately so republishing the same graph does not look like 30 products.

meters.title: Events published
meters.body: Business activity flowing through FlowOS: OrderCreated, PaymentCompleted, InventoryReserved. This is what should grow as a customer succeeds.

meters.title: MCP tool calls
meters.body: How often an agent talks to the control plane. Included allowances stay large so a developer is not afraid to ask “why did this fail?”
